result.brief: 提出基于模拟器的刚体物理基准 RigidBench，用 6-DoF 轨迹、接触等分离指标评测视频生成模型的物理正确性，并提供 5000 条精确状态训练视频用于微调 Wan 2.2。
result.reason: Simulator-grounded benchmark for rigid-body physics in video generation models, with 6-DoF trajectories, contacts, and fine-tuning of Wan 2.2; directly supports video world models and video generation evaluation.
